registration.classification: exploratory reanalysis designed after development observations
registration.selection: all L1/L2 scans, all counts, no threshold or best-count selection

selection: All available L1/L2 scans and every R=1..8; no best-R, threshold or successful-model filtering.
statistical_unit: Means over initializations within each world, then equal world means. Bands are world ranges, not confidence intervals.
interpretation: Output-level atomic extractability versus composite success; neither internal-encoding localization nor proof of MLP-exclusive knowledge storage.
